Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, the following terms shall mean:

1. Regency is Musi Rawas Utara Regency.
2. Regency Government is the Government of Musi Rawas Utara Regency.
3. Regent is the Regent of Musi Rawas Utara.
4. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regional Head and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
5. Village Community Empowerment and Women and Children Protection Agency hereinafter referred to as the Agency is the Regional Apparatus that administers Women Empowerment and Child Protection affairs in Musi Rawas Utara Regency.
6. Woman is a person who has female genitalia who can menstruate and become pregnant or has obtained legal status as a woman.
7. Child is a person who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old, including a child who is still in the womb.
8. Protection is any effort aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
9. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
10. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and his children, and mother and her children and persons who are under their responsibility.
11. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or adoptive mother.
12. Guardian is a person or body who in fact exercises parental authority as Parents over a Child.
13. Child with Disabilities is a Child who has physical, mental, intellectual, or sensory limitations for a long period of time which in interacting with the environment and community attitudes may encounter obstacles that make it difficult to participate fully and effectively based on equal rights.
14. Child with Special Talents is a Child who has extraordinary intelligence or has potential and/or special talents not limited to intellectual abilities, but also in other fields.
15. Violence is any act that results in or can result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, or psychological to the victim.
16. Child-Friendly Regency is a Regency that has a child rights-based development system through the integration of government commitment and resources, community and business world, which is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights and protection.
17. Regional Medium-Term Development Plan hereinafter abbreviated as RPJMD is a Regional planning document for a period of 5 (five) years counting from inauguration until the end of the Regent's term of office.
18. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget hereinafter abbreviated as APBD, is the Annual Financial Plan of Regional Government established by Regional Regulation.
19. Regional Action Plan is a document containing policies, programs and activities in order to realize objectives in accordance with regional authority.
20. Integrated Service Center for Women Empowerment and Child Protection, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service center in efforts to empower women in various fields of development, as well as protection of women and children from various types of discrimination and acts of violence, including trafficking in persons, established by the government or community-based.
21. Person with Disabilities is any person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience obstacles and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

Any person who deliberately allows violence against women and children to occur and/or does not report the occurrence of violence against women and children shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.

1. Regency is Musi Rawas Utara Regency.

11. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or adoptive mother.
12. Guardian is a person or body who in fact exercises parental authority as Parents over a Child.

15. Violence is any act that results in or can result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, or psychological to the victim.

a. receive humane treatment and placement separated from adults;
b. obtain legal assistance or other assistance effectively at every stage of applicable legal proceedings; and
